name: PM-KISAN
description: Income support for eligible landholding farmers.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly to the farmer's bank account in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 each every four months.
application_process: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Agriculture Department office. Self-registration is available on the PM-KISAN portal. Farmer must complete Aadhaar-based eKYC to receive instalments.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefits: Crop insurance cover for losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases. Premium rates: up to 2% for Kharif crops, up to 1.5% for Rabi crops, and up to 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops. The balance premium is shared by Central and State Governments.
application_process: Apply through your nearest bank branch (especially where KCC is held), CSC, or online at pmfby.gov.in. Loanee farmers are auto-enrolled; non-loanee farmers must apply before the cut-off date for each season.

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefits: Revolving credit facility for agricultural needs: crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, allied activities, and consumption needs. Interest subvention of 2% available; additional 3% incentive for prompt repayment, reducing effective interest to around 4% per annum. Credit limit up to ₹3 lakh under the short-term loan component.
application_process: Apply at any scheduled commercial bank, cooperative bank, or regional rural bank. Submit the KCC application form with land records and identity proof. The bank will assess the credit limit based on cultivated area and crop pattern.
helpline: Contact your bank branch or NABARD helpline: 022-26539895

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
benefits: Improved irrigation efficiency; subsidy support for micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler) under the PDMC component. Helps farmers reduce water usage and improve crop productivity.
application_process: Farmers can apply for micro-irrigation subsidies (drip/sprinkler) through the state horticulture or agriculture department portals.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefits: Free soil health card containing soil nutrient status and recommendations for fertiliser dosage and soil amendments for each farm plot. Helps reduce input costs and improve yields.
application_process: Contact your state Agriculture Department or the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra. Soil samples are collected from your field by government officials. The card is issued within 6–8 weeks of sample submission.

name: PM-KUSUM
description: Solar pumps and renewable energy support for farmers.
benefits: Subsidy of up to 60% on solar pump installation (30% from Central Government, 30% from State Government); farmers pay only 10% (additional 10% as loan in some states). Component-A: grid-connected solar power plants on barren/fallow land; Component-B: standalone solar agriculture pumps; Component-C: solarisation of grid-connected pumps.
application_process: Apply through your State Nodal Agency (SNA) or DISCOM. Visit the PM-KUSUM portal or contact the State Agriculture / Renewable Energy Department.

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
benefits: Access to a national online trading platform for agricultural commodities. Enables farmers to get better prices by connecting with buyers across India. Transparent price discovery through electronic bidding.
application_process: Register at your nearest APMC/mandi that is integrated with e-NAM. Alternatively, register online at enam.gov.in.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
benefits: Credit-linked, interest subvention of 3% per annum on loans up to ₹2 crore for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets. Credit guarantee cover through CGTMSE.
application_process: Apply online at agriinfra.dac.gov.in or through your bank/PACS/APMC.

name: National Mission on Natural Farming
description: Support for natural and sustainable farming.
benefits: Financial support to farmers transitioning to natural farming practices: training, demonstrations, and input support. Reduces dependency on chemical inputs and lowers cultivation costs.
application_process: Contact your State Agriculture Department or local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK). Register on the National Natural Farming Mission portal when available, or apply through the state nodal agency.

name: Pradhan Mantri Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana
description: Development of selected low-productivity agricultural districts.
benefits: Comprehensive agriculture and rural credit initiative aimed at strengthening agricultural infrastructure, storage, market linkages, and crop diversification for farmers.
application_process: Facilitated through primary agricultural credit societies (PACS), state agriculture departments, and rural cooperative banks.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefits: Health insurance cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation. Covers pre- and post-hospitalisation expenses, medicine, diagnostics, and more. Cashless and paperless treatment at empanelled government and private hospitals.
application_process: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call the helpline. Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Ayushman Mitra at an empanelled hospital to get your Ayushman card. Beneficiaries from SECC-2011 database are auto-enrolled.

name: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres
documents: Identity card / ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) ID
benefits: Comprehensive primary healthcare delivered closer to homes, offering free essential drugs, diagnostic services, maternal & child healthcare, screening and management of non-communicable diseases (hypertension, diabetes, cancers).
application_process: Walk-in to the nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health and Wellness Centre) or Sub-Health Centre in your village or urban ward.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana
documents: Valid doctor's prescription (required to purchase prescription-only generic medicines; no document needed for OTC products)
benefits: Quality generic medicines at prices 50–90% lower than branded medicines, available at Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendras.
application_process: Visit the nearest Pradhan Mantri Janaushadhi Kendra with a doctor's prescription to purchase medicines.

name: Mission Indradhanush
documents: Mother & Child Protection (MCP) card / child vaccination record (if available; vaccination is provided even without prior documents)
benefits: Free vaccination for children (0–2 years) and pregnant women against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases including polio, diphtheria, TB, hepatitis B, and others.
application_process: Visit the nearest government health centre or Anganwadi Centre. Immunisation is provided free of cost during scheduled rounds and routine immunisation sessions.

name: National Health Mission
description: Rural and urban public health services.
documents: No prior documentation for emergency care; Aadhaar/voter ID and ANC/Mother-Child card for maternity benefits at public health facilities.
benefits: Strengthens public healthcare infrastructure across rural and urban areas; provides universal access to equitable, affordable quality healthcare, institutional deliveries (JSY), free ambulance services, and national disease control programs.
application_process: Access services directly through government sub-centres, Primary Health Centres (PHCs), Community Health Centres (CHCs), and District Hospitals.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
documents: Bank account / post office account details
benefits: Maternity benefit of ₹5,000 (for the first live birth) in instalments to compensate for wage loss and improve health and nutrition of pregnant women and lactating mothers.
application_process: Register and apply at the Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or Approved Health Facility. Claims are submitted in three instalments linked to antenatal check-ups and delivery.

name: eSanjeevani
documents: Previous medical records / prescriptions (optional for doctor consultation)
benefits: Free teleconsultation with government doctors from home. No travel required. Available 7 days a week.
application_process: Register and book an appointment at esanjeevaniopd.in or download the eSanjeevani app.

name: PM-ABHIM
benefits: Pan-India infrastructure mission to strengthen health systems and institutions for pandemic preparedness, establishing critical care hospital blocks in districts and integrated public health labs.
application_process: Central and State health infrastructure funding program implemented through state health departments; no direct citizen application.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh (plain areas) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) for construction of a pucca house. Additionally, ₹12,000 for toilet construction under SBM-G and 90/95 person-days of unskilled labour under MGNREGS.
application_process: Beneficiaries are selected from the SECC-2011 database. Contact your Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office to verify your inclusion. Funds are transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account in instalments.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban 2.0
benefits: Interest subsidy (Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme — CLSS) on home loans for eligible beneficiaries; direct beneficiary transfer for construction in slums; affordable housing in partnership. Subsidy varies by income category (EWS/LIG/MIG).
application_process: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or at your Urban Local Body (ULB) office. For CLSS, apply through your lending institution (bank/HFC).

name: Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin
benefits: Incentive of ₹12,000 per household for construction of an individual household toilet.
application_process: Apply through your Gram Panchayat. The incentive is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account after verification of toilet construction.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban
documents: Photograph of applicant and toilet construction site
benefits: Incentive subsidy of up to ₹4,000 to ₹10,000 (varying with central/state share) for construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL) in urban areas, community toilets, and municipal solid waste management support.
application_process: Apply online at sbmurban.org or swachhbharaturban.gov.in under the IHHL portal or apply via local Urban Local Body (ULB) / Municipality office.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
documents: Household identity proof / electricity bill / Gram Panchayat village residence record (as required by local Village Water & Sanitation Committee)
benefits: Functional household tap-water connection (FHTC) providing safe and adequate drinking water to every rural household.
application_process: Apply through your Gram Panchayat Water and Sanitation Committee (VWSC) or Pani Samiti. Implementation is through state governments and Gram Panchayats.

name: AMRUT / Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation
benefits: Urban rejuvenation program providing universal coverage of water supply, sewerage networks, storm water drainage, urban green spaces, and non-motorized urban transport in designated mission cities.
application_process: City-wide urban infrastructure scheme executed through Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) and state housing and urban affairs departments.

name: PM SVANidhi
documents: Certificate of vending / Letter of recommendation from ULB/TVC
benefits: Working capital loan: ₹10,000 (first term), ₹20,000 (second term), ₹50,000 (third term). Interest subsidy of 7% per annum. No collateral required. Digital transactions incentivised.
application_process: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through lending institutions (banks, MFIs, SFBs). Eligible street vendors must have a certificate of vending or letter of recommendation.

name: Samagra Shiksha
description: School education from pre-primary through senior secondary levels.
benefits: Universal access to school education from pre-school to senior secondary; covers free textbooks, uniforms, ICT labs, vocational education, and inclusive education for children with special needs.
application_process: Implemented through government and government-aided schools across India; admissions done via local school enrolment drives.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
documents: Income certificate (family income below ₹3.5 lakh per annum)
benefits: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for meritorious students from economically weaker sections studying in Classes 9–12 in government schools.
application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Students must pass the NMMS examination conducted by states/UTs.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship schemes
description: Support for students from designated social categories.
benefits: Scholarships for eligible students from SC, ST, OBC, and minority communities studying from Class 11 onwards, including vocational and professional courses.
application_process: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

name: Top Class Education Scheme
description: Higher-education support for eligible SC students.
documents: Income certificate (family income up to ₹8 lakh p.a.)
benefits: Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges, living expenses stipend of ₹3,000 per month, books and stationery allowance of ₹5,000 per annum, and latest computer/laptop grant of ₹45,000 one-time for SC/ST students studying in notified top institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, etc.).
application_process: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at scholarships.gov.in under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Tribal Affairs section.

name: National Overseas Scholarship
description: Overseas study support for eligible candidates.
documents: Family income certificate (income ceiling ₹8 lakh p.a.)
Unconditional offer letter from accredited foreign university
benefits: Financial assistance covering annual tuition fees, maintenance allowance ($15,400 for USA/other countries, GBP 9,900 for UK), contingency allowance, visa fees, medical insurance, and economy class air passage for low-income SC, De-notified Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes, Landless Agricultural Labourers and Traditional Artisans pursuing Master's or Ph.D. abroad.
application_process: Apply online on the official NOS portal (nosmsje.gov.in) when applications open annually.

name: PM POSHAN
benefits: Free mid-day meal (cooked hot food) for children studying in Classes 1–8 in government and government-aided schools.
application_process: Children enrolled in eligible government or government-aided schools automatically receive meals. No separate application is required.

name: National Scholarship Portal
description: A common platform for many Central and State scholarships.
documents: Student identity card / Bonafide student certificate
Caste / Community certificate (if applying under reserved category)
benefits: Single platform to access and apply for multiple Central and State Government scholarships.
application_process: Register and apply at scholarships.gov.in. Select the relevant scholarship scheme and submit required documents online.

name: PM-USHA
benefits: Strategic funding to state higher educational institutions to improve quality, research, access, equity, and state-level higher education accreditation and infrastructure.
application_process: Institutional grant scheme submitted by State Higher Education Councils (SHEC) and universities to the Ministry of Education.

name: PM SHRI Schools
documents: Standard school enrollment documents as per KV, JNV, or State government school admission rules.
benefits: Upgradation of over 14,500 schools into exemplary institutions showcasing the National Education Policy 2020 with smart classrooms, laboratories, pedagogy innovation, and green campus standards.
application_process: Schools are selected by challenge method; students gain admission through standard school enrolment processes of the selected PM SHRI schools.

name: SHRESHTA
description: Educational opportunities for eligible SC students.
benefits: Residential school education in quality private schools for meritorious SC students from Classes 9–12.
application_process: Apply through the SHRESHTA portal (shreshta.socialjustice.gov.in) after the entrance examination notification.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarships
description: Scholarships for SC, ST, OBC, minority and other eligible students.
benefits: Scholarships for students from SC, ST, OBC, minority, and other eligible categories studying in Classes 1–10 to prevent dropout.
application_process: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) after registering.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)
description: Guaranteed rural wage employment, subject to eligibility.
benefits: Guarantee of 100 days of unskilled wage employment per household per financial year. Wages are paid at the notified statutory minimum wage for agricultural labourers in the state. Employment must be provided within 15 days of application, failing which an unemployment allowance is due.
application_process: Apply for a Job Card at your Gram Panchayat. Once you hold a Job Card, submit a written application for work to the Gram Panchayat or Programme Officer at least 14 days in advance.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
benefits: Free short-term skill training (duration: 150–300+ hours) aligned with industry-recognised qualification packs. Includes placement assistance and a monetary reward/stipend for trainees from certain categories. A nationally recognised certificate is issued on successful assessment.
application_process: Register online at skillindiadigital.gov.in or locate a nearby PMKVY Training Centre (TC) affiliated with the Sector Skill Council. Walk-in enrolment is also available at training centres.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
benefits: Free residential skill training for rural youth (15–35 years). Includes placement assistance with minimum wage guarantee for placed candidates.
application_process: Contact your Block or District Mission Management Unit (BMMU/DMMU) or registered Project Implementing Agency (PIA).

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme
benefits: Government reimburses 25% of prescribed stipend (up to ₹1,500/month) to the employer for each apprentice. Apprentices gain industry experience and a nationally recognised certificate.
application_process: Register as an apprentice at apprenticeshipindia.org or through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme portal.

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Training, tools, credit, and marketing support for traditional artisans.
benefits: Recognition as Vishwakarma; up to 5 days of basic training with ₹500/day stipend; advanced skill training; toolkit incentive of up to ₹15,000; collateral-free credit support at concessional rate of 5% (₹1 lakh in first tranche, ₹2 lakh in second); digital transaction incentive and market linkage support.
application_process: Apply online at pmvishwakarma.gov.in or through the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Registration is done via Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body facilitation.

name: PM-DAKSH
description: Skill development and entrepreneurship support for eligible disadvantaged groups.
benefits: Free skill development training for SC, OBC, DNT, EBC, and sanitation workers. Placement assistance and stipend during training.
application_process: Apply online at pmdaksh.dosje.gov.in or through the implementing Training Partner.

name: Startup India
benefits: Income tax exemption for 3 years; self-certification under 6 labour and 3 environment laws; easier winding up; access to Fund of Funds, Startup India Seed Fund, and credit guarantee schemes.
application_process: Apply for DPIIT recognition at startupindia.gov.in. Recognition is granted online within 2 working days after application review.

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank loans for eligible SC/ST entrepreneurs and women entrepreneurs.
benefits: Bank loan between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for setting up a greenfield enterprise. For SC/ST borrowers and women entrepreneurs.
application_process: Apply online at standupmitra.in or at any scheduled commercial bank. The loan covers 75% of the project cost including working capital.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Micro-enterprise loans for micro and small businesses.
benefits: Collateral-free loans for non-farm micro and small enterprises: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001–₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh–₹10 lakh). Available through scheduled commercial banks, MFIs, and NBFCs.
application_process: Apply at any bank branch, NBFC, or MFI offering MUDRA loans, or apply online at mudra.org.in / udyamimitra.in. Submit the MUDRA application form with supporting documents.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
benefits: Subsidy (Margin Money) of 15–35% of project cost (higher for rural areas and special categories) for setting up new micro-enterprises. Project cost: up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) / ₹20 lakh (service).
application_process: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal or at the KVIC/KVIB/DIC office. After application, interview at District Level Task Force (DLTFC), bank sanction, and margin money release.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana
description: Basic bank accounts and financial inclusion.
documents: OR any officially valid document (OVD): Voter ID, Driving licence, PAN card, NREGA Job Card
benefits: Zero-balance savings account with a RuPay debit card. Free accidental insurance cover of ₹2 lakh (₹1 lakh for accounts opened before 28 Aug 2018). Life insurance cover of ₹30,000. Overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 for eligible account holders. Access to Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) from government schemes.
application_process: Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent (BC) / Banking Mitra with identity proof. Fill in the account opening form. For small accounts, self-certification of identity is acceptable.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefits: Life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh on death due to any cause. Annual premium of ₹436 (auto-debited from linked bank account).
application_process: Enrol through your bank branch or via net banking / mobile banking. The premium is auto-debited from the linked savings account annually on 1 June.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefits: Accident insurance: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total disability; ₹1 lakh for partial disability. Annual premium of ₹20.
application_process: Enrol through your bank branch or via net banking / mobile banking. The premium of ₹20 is auto-debited from the linked account annually on 1 June.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
documents: Savings bank account / post office savings account
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 (subscriber's choice) after age 60. On subscriber's death, the spouse receives the same pension; on both deaths, the accumulated pension wealth is returned to the nominee.
application_process: Open an APY account at any bank or post office branch, or through net banking / mobile banking. Fill the APY subscriber registration form and set up auto-debit of contributions.

name: National Pension System
benefits: Market-linked pension savings with tax benefits under Sections 80C and 80CCD(1B) of the Income Tax Act. Flexible investment options; partial withdrawal allowed for specific purposes after 3 years.
application_process: Register online at eNPS portal (enps.nsdl.com) or at a Point of Presence (PoP) such as a bank branch.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Savings account for eligible girl children.
documents: Parent's / guardian's Aadhaar card and PAN card
benefits: High-interest savings scheme (interest rate set quarterly by Government; 8.2% for Q1 FY 2024-25). Tax benefits under Section 80C. Maturity amount and interest are exempt from tax. Account matures 21 years from the date of opening or on the girl's marriage after age 18.
application_process: Open the account at any post office or authorised bank. A parent or legal guardian can open one account per girl child (maximum two accounts per family).

name: Public Provident Fund
benefits: Government-backed savings with tax deduction under Section 80C (up to ₹1.5 lakh per year). Interest rate set quarterly by the Government. Interest and maturity proceeds are exempt from tax. Loan facility from 3rd to 6th year; partial withdrawal from 7th year.
application_process: Open the account at any post office or authorised bank branch. Minimum deposit ₹500 per year; maximum ₹1.5 lakh per year.

name: Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme
documents: Age proof (passport, voter ID, birth certificate)
benefits: High-interest savings scheme for senior citizens (8.2% for Q1 FY 2024-25). Quarterly interest payout. Tax benefit under Section 80C.
application_process: Open the account at any post office or authorised bank branch. Maximum deposit ₹30 lakh per individual.

name: Kisan Vikas Patra
benefits: Doubles the invested amount in a fixed period (currently approximately 115 months / 9 years 7 months). Government-backed; available at post offices and authorised banks.
application_process: Purchase KVP certificates at any post office or authorised bank branch. Minimum investment ₹1,000.

name: National Social Assistance Programme
description: Pensions and assistance for eligible elderly, widows, and persons with disabilities.
documents: Age proof / disability certificate / widow certificate
benefits: Monthly social assistance pension: IGNOAPS (elderly ≥ 60 yrs: ₹200–₹500/month), IGNWPS (widows: ₹300/month), IGNDPS (severe disability: ₹300/month), NFBS (bereaved family on death of primary breadwinner: ₹20,000 one-time).
application_process: Apply at the Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body / District Social Welfare Office.

name: Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao
documents: Bank / Post office account passbook (if opening Sukanya Samriddhi account)
benefits: Awareness campaigns, community mobilisation, and incentive programmes to improve the child sex ratio and promote girl-child education. No direct cash transfer; benefits are delivered through local initiatives.
application_process: BBBP is primarily an advocacy and district-level convergence campaign to improve Child Sex Ratio and promote girls' education. Families can participate through local Anganwadi Centres, district health offices, and by enrolling girls in school and Sukanya Samriddhi accounts.

name: Mission Shakti
documents: Relevant police/medical reports (for Sambal emergency intervention)
Bank account details (for Samarthya maternity/skill interventions)
benefits: Women's safety, empowerment, and rehabilitation services. Includes SAMBAL (safety and security) and SAMARTHYA (empowerment) sub-schemes.
application_process: Access assistance via One Stop Centres (OSC), Women Helplines (181), or through local District Hubs for Empowerment of Women (DHEW) and Anganwadi centres.

name: One Stop Centre Scheme
description: Assistance for women affected by violence.
documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar / voter ID, if available; no document is mandatory in medical/police emergencies)
benefits: Integrated support services for women affected by violence: medical, legal, psychological, shelter, and police assistance under one roof.
application_process: Contact the nearest One Stop Centre (Sakhi Centre). Helpline 181 connects women to the nearest OSC.

name: Women Helpline Scheme
documents: No prior documentation required to access emergency toll-free crisis intervention
benefits: 24x7 emergency support, counselling, referral to police, legal, medical, and other services.
application_process: Dial 181 from any phone.

name: Ujjwala Scheme
documents: BPL ration card / PMUY eligibility proof
benefits: Free LPG connection (security deposit waived) for eligible households. First refill and hotplate are provided free of cost. Reduces indoor air pollution and improves health outcomes for women.
application_process: Apply at the nearest LPG distributor (IOC, BPCL, HPCL) with the KYC form. Eligible categories include BPL households, PMAY-G beneficiaries, MGNREGS card holders, SC/ST households, forest dwellers, and others listed under PMUY 2.0.

name: Mission Vatsalya
documents: Child's birth certificate / hospital birth record
Income certificate / proof of destitution (where applicable)
Child Welfare Committee (CWC) referral or order (for institutional care)
benefits: Child protection services, institutional and non-institutional care, rehabilitation, and welfare for children in difficult circumstances.
application_process: Contact the District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) or Child Welfare Committee (CWC) in your district.

name: Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0
documents: Child birth certificate / MCP card (Mother and Child Protection Card)
benefits: Nutrition supplementation, growth monitoring, health check-ups, and referral services for children (0–6 years), pregnant women, and lactating mothers through Anganwadi Centres.
application_process: Register at your nearest Anganwadi Centre.

name: Palna Scheme
benefits: Subsidised crèche services for children of working mothers (6 months to 6 years). Includes nutrition, healthcare, and education support.
application_process: Apply at the nearest Palna crèche centre. Contact your Women and Child Development Department.
helpline: Ministry of Women and Child Development: 011-23386423

name: National Food Security Act
description: Subsidised food grains for eligible beneficiaries.
documents: Aadhaar card (for eKYC at PDS shops)
benefits: Eligible households receive subsidised food grains: up to 5 kg per person per month at ₹3/kg (rice), ₹2/kg (wheat), ₹1/kg (coarse cereals). Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) households receive 35 kg/month.
application_process: Apply for a ration card at the nearest Food & Civil Supplies Department or online through the state's food portal. Once a ration card is issued, collect entitlements from the designated Fair Price Shop.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
description: Food-grain support under the public distribution system.
benefits: Free food grains (5 kg per person per month) to all NFSA beneficiaries under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana.
application_process: Collect entitlements from your designated Fair Price Shop (PDS outlet) using your ration card and Aadhaar.
helpline: National Food Security Portal Toll Free: 1967 / 1800-180-2087

name: Antyodaya Anna Yojana
benefits: 35 kg of food grains per household per month at heavily subsidised rates (₹3/kg rice, ₹2/kg wheat, ₹1/kg coarse cereals).
application_process: Apply for an Antyodaya ration card at the state Food & Civil Supplies Department. Eligibility is determined by the state government.
helpline: National Food Security Portal Toll Free: 1967

name: One Nation One Ration Card
description: Portability of ration benefits across India.
documents: Aadhaar card linked to ration card
benefits: Portability of ration card entitlements across all states and UTs in India. Migrant workers can collect food grains from any PDS shop in the country.
application_process: Your existing ration card is automatically enabled for portability if your state is integrated with ONORC. Use the mera ration app or visit any PDS shop.

name: PM Garib Kalyan packages
description: Various welfare measures for vulnerable groups.
benefits: Emergency welfare and relief package launched during COVID-19 pandemic providing food security, cash transfers to women Jan Dhan accounts, free LPG refills under PMUY, and insurance for healthcare workers.
application_process: Relief initiative administered directly to pre-existing verified beneficiary databases; currently succeeded by integrated welfare programs like PMGKAY.

name: Direct Benefit Transfer
description: Electronic transfer of eligible benefits into bank accounts.
documents: Bank account passbook (Aadhaar linked / NPCI seeded)
benefits: Direct electronic transfer of welfare subsidies and benefits directly into citizen bank accounts linked with Aadhaar, eliminating intermediaries and leakage.
application_process: Citizens ensure their Aadhaar is linked to their bank account and NPCI mapper; specific benefit enrolments take place through individual welfare scheme portals.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
benefits: Construction of all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations across India, enhancing economic opportunities and rural mobility.
application_process: Infrastructure program executed by National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency (NRIDA) and State Rural Road Development Agencies (SRRDA).

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission
description: Self-help groups, women's SHGs and enterprise support for rural livelihoods.
benefits: Support for women's self-help groups (SHGs): initial corpus fund, revolving fund, community investment support, skill training, and livelihood assistance. Access to low-cost credit through SHG-Bank linkage.
application_process: Join or form a Self-Help Group (SHG) in your village. Contact your Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU) or Panchayat Raj Institution.

name: Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission
benefits: Development of 300 Rurban clusters that have economic and social potential, delivering integrated rural services and economic amenities.
application_process: District and cluster-level rural development mission implemented through state rural development departments.

name: Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana
benefits: Integrated socio-economic development of villages having >50% Scheduled Caste population through convergence of basic infrastructure and welfare amenities.
application_process: Village-level developmental scheme executed under PM-AJAY through District Magistrates and Gram Panchayats.

name: Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana
benefits: Holistic transformation of identified model Gram Panchayats adopted by Members of Parliament to achieve physical and institutional infrastructure convergence.
application_process: Community-driven development plan prepared and executed by the adopted Gram Panchayat and District Collectorate.

name: BharatNet
benefits: High-speed broadband telecom infrastructure connecting all Gram Panchayats and rural habitations across India to support digital governance and connectivity.
application_process: Digital infrastructure initiative implemented by Bharat Broadband Network Limited (BBNL) and BSNL; access provided through local WiFi Choupal / FTTH connections.

name: Aspirational Districts Programme
benefits: Targeted transformation of 112 most backward districts in key sectors: health & nutrition, education, agriculture & water resources, financial inclusion & skill development, and basic infrastructure.
application_process: District-level governance tracking framework driven by NITI Aayog; benefits converge into district residents through existing flagship schemes.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
benefits: Subsidy for rooftop solar installation: up to ₹30,000 for 1 kW; up to ₹60,000 for 2 kW; up to ₹78,000 for 3 kW and above. Free electricity up to 300 units/month for eligible households.
application_process: Apply at pmsuryaghar.gov.in. Choose a registered vendor; subsidy is released through your DISCOM after inspection.

name: UJALA
documents: Photo ID proof (Aadhaar card / voter card)
Cash / digital payment for subsidized energy-efficient appliances
benefits: Energy-efficient LED bulbs, tube lights, and fans at subsidised prices.
application_process: Collect LED bulbs from designated DISCOM distribution points or empanelled shops against surrender of working incandescent/CFL bulbs.

name: Saubhagya
benefits: Free electricity connection for BPL households; ₹500 connection fee (payable in 10 instalments of ₹50) for APL households.
application_process: Apply through your local DISCOM or state electricity distribution company office. Camp-mode connections are organised in unelectrified villages.

name: FAME India
description: Promotion of electric and hybrid vehicles.
documents: Vehicle registration and sales invoice details from authorized EV dealership
benefits: Upfront purchase incentive and subsidy support for electric vehicles (two-wheelers, three-wheelers, four-wheelers, and electric buses) and development of EV charging infrastructure.
application_process: Demand incentive is passed on directly to the buyer as a price reduction at the time of purchase by registered EV OEMs and dealers.

name: National Clean Air Programme
benefits: National target to reduce particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10) concentrations by 20% to 40% across non-attainment cities through air quality monitoring, EV adoption, and industrial emission control.
application_process: Implemented through Central and State Pollution Control Boards and City Municipal Corporations; monitored via the PRANA portal.

name: National Mission for Clean Ganga / Namami Gange Programme
benefits: Comprehensive conservation mission to clean and rejuvenate River Ganga through sewage treatment infrastructure, riverfront development, afforestation, and public awareness.
application_process: Institutional mission executed by National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) under Ministry of Jal Shakti.

name: Mission LiFE
benefits: Global mass movement led by India encouraging citizens to adopt sustainable, environmentally conscious lifestyle behaviors (energy saving, water conservation, single-use plastic reduction).
application_process: Citizens can join the campaign, take environmental pledges, and track eco-friendly actions at missionlife-moefcc.nic.in.

name: Green Credit Programme
documents: Land ownership/usage rights documents (for plantation/water harvesting activities)
benefits: Market-based mechanism incentivizing voluntary environmental actions (tree plantation, water management, sustainable agriculture, waste management) by issuing tradeable Green Credits.
application_process: Register on the Green Credit Portal (moefcc.gov.in / gcp-cpcb.in) and submit application with details of voluntary eco-restoration activity for verification by Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE).

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
description: Collateral-free credit support and credit guarantees for eligible micro and small enterprises.
benefits: Credit guarantee cover of 75–85% (up to 90% for select categories) on collateral-free loans up to ₹5 crore for micro and small enterprises.
application_process: Apply for the loan at any Member Lending Institution (MLI) such as a scheduled commercial bank. The lending institution then applies for the CGTMSE guarantee cover.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
benefits: Funding support of up to ₹20 lakh for validation and ₹50 lakh for product development/commercialisation for early-stage startups.
application_process: Apply through incubators empanelled under the Startup India Seed Fund Scheme at startupindia.gov.in.

name: Fund of Funds for Startups
documents: Business pitch deck and financial statements
benefits: Venture capital corpus of ₹10,000 crore managed by SIDBI to invest in SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), which in turn invest equity capital into Indian startups.
application_process: Startups receive investments through SIDBI-partnered Venture Capital Funds / AIFs; details accessible via Startup India hub.

name: Production Linked Incentive schemes
documents: Company incorporation details and GST registration
Audited financial statements and investment commitment proofs
Chartered Accountant / statutory auditor certificates for incremental sales & CAPEX
benefits: Financial incentives of 4% to 6% on incremental sales of goods manufactured in India across 14 key sectors (electronics, pharmaceuticals, telecom, auto, textiles, solar PV, etc.).
application_process: Apply through sector-specific Project Management Agencies (PMAs) like IFCI or SIDBI under designated window calls by relevant administrative ministries.

name: National Logistics Policy
benefits: Policy framework to reduce logistics costs in India from ~13% to single digits through Unified Logistics Interface Platform (ULIP) and multimodal logistics parks.
application_process: Policy framework and digital integration platform for logistics service providers and industry stakeholders.

name: Make in India
documents: Company registration, industrial license, and sector approvals (as applicable to the enterprise)
benefits: Investment facilitation, FDI liberalization, infrastructure development, and ease of doing business reforms to foster manufacturing and entrepreneurship in India.
application_process: Companies and entrepreneurs can explore investment opportunities, connect with Invest India facilitators at makeinindia.com.

name: Digital India
description: Digital infrastructure, services, and technology adoption.
benefits: Flagship initiative transforming India into a digitally empowered society through digital infrastructure (broadband, identity), digital services on demand (e-governance, digital payments), and digital literacy.
application_process: Umbrella program spanning multiple e-governance initiatives; citizen services are accessible via individual portals (DigiLocker, UMANG, Aadhaar, UPI).

name: PM-AJAY
description: Development and employment support for Scheduled Castes.
benefits: Scholarships, vocational training, income-generation activities, and village development support for SC communities.
application_process: Apply through the respective sub-scheme components (PMAGY, NSFDC credit, PM-DAKSH for SC). Contact your District SC Welfare Office.
helpline: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment: 011-23382391

name: PM-JANMAN
description: Support for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.
benefits: Housing, road connectivity, clean drinking water, sanitation, mobile health and education services for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).
application_process: Benefits are delivered through state tribal welfare departments. Contact your State Tribal Welfare Office or District Collector.

name: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan
benefits: Saturation initiative for tribal villages covering ~5 crore tribal population across 63,000 villages with pucca houses, all-weather road connectivity, water supply, electricity, healthcare, and education infrastructure.
application_process: Convergence-based government saturation mission implemented via Central Ministries and State Tribal Development Departments; no individual application needed.

name: Van Dhan Yojana
description: Tribal entrepreneurship and forest-produce value addition.
benefits: Tribal entrepreneurs receive training, working capital, and market linkage for Minor Forest Produce (MFP) value addition through Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs).
application_process: Join or form a Van Dhan Self-Help Group. Contact your state's TRIFED representative or District Tribal Welfare Office.

name: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation schemes
documents: Income certificate (below double the poverty line)
benefits: Concessional loans (4–8% interest) for income-generating activities and skill development for SC individuals.
application_process: Apply through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs) in your state.

name: National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation schemes
documents: Proof of community engagement in sanitation work
benefits: Concessional loans, training, and rehabilitation support for sanitation workers and their dependants.
application_process: Apply through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs) or NSKFDC regional offices.

name: SEED
description: Economic empowerment of denotified, nomadic, and semi-nomadic communities.
benefits: Economic empowerment, education support, health linkage, and livelihood assistance for denotified, nomadic, and semi-nomadic communities.
application_process: Contact the District Social Welfare Office or Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

name: Schemes for minorities
description: Scholarships, education, livelihood, and infrastructure support.
benefits: Pre-matric scholarships, post-matric scholarships, merit-cum-means scholarships, Naya Savera (free coaching), Hamari Dharohar, and Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram.
application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) for scholarship schemes.
helpline: Ministry of Minority Affairs Toll Free: 1800-11-2001

name: Agnipath Scheme
documents: Character certificate and NCC/Sports certificate (if applicable)
benefits: 4-year contractual engagement in the Indian Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force) with monthly package (₹30,000 to ₹40,000), Seva Nidhi financial exit package of ~₹11.71 lakh (tax-free), non-contributory life insurance cover of ₹48 lakh, and skill certification. Up to 25% enrolled into regular cadre.
application_process: Apply online during recruitment cycles via official Indian Army (joinindianarmy.nic.in), Indian Navy (joinindiannavy.gov.in), or Indian Air Force (agnipathvayu.cdac.in) recruitment portals.

name: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme
description: Healthcare for eligible veterans and dependants.
benefits: Cashless medical treatment for retired armed forces personnel and their eligible dependants at ECHS polyclinics and empanelled hospitals.
application_process: Apply for ECHS membership at your nearest ECHS station HQ or Record Office. Submit the application along with discharge book and photographs.

name: Armed Forces Flag Day Fund schemes
description: Welfare support for armed forces personnel and families.
benefits: Welfare support including education scholarships, housing, medical assistance, and rehabilitation for armed forces personnel, veterans, and their families.
application_process: Apply through Zila Sainik Boards or the Kendriya Sainik Board.

name: DigiLocker
benefits: Cloud platform for issuing and verifying digital certificates and documents eliminating physical paperwork; offers 1 GB cloud storage linked to citizen Aadhaar.
application_process: Visit digilocker.gov.in or download the DigiLocker mobile app. Sign up with Aadhaar number, verify via OTP, set a 6-digit security PIN, and search for documents issued by central/state governments, universities, and banks.

name: UMANG
description: Access to multiple government services through one platform.
benefits: Unified mobile platform providing single-point access to over 1,200 central and state government services including EPF, PAN, Aadhaar, DigiLocker, scholarships, utility bills, and pension services.
application_process: Download UMANG app from Google Play / Apple App Store or access web portal at web.umang.gov.in. Register using mobile number and explore available ministry services.

name: Common Service Centres
description: Assisted access to digital government services.
documents: For Citizens seeking services: Aadhaar, relevant application documents as per specific scheme.
For VLE (Village Level Entrepreneur) applicants: Aadhaar card, PAN card, 10th pass certificate, cancelled cheque, photo of CSC center.
benefits: Access points for delivery of essential public utility services, social welfare schemes, healthcare, financial, education, and agriculture services to rural and remote citizens.
application_process: Citizens can locate and walk into the nearest CSC center. Prospective operators can apply to become a Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) via register.csc.gov.in with a TEC (Telecentre Entrepreneur Course) certificate.
